description: This file defines the TlsDuplexPipe class, which is a specialized stream adapter for handling SSL/TLS encrypted communication over a duplex pipe, extending functionality from DuplexPipeStreamAdapter with SslStream.

classes.name: TlsDuplexPipe
classes.description: A stream adapter that encapsulates an SslStream over a duplex pipe, providing secure communication.

methods.name: TlsDuplexPipe (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TlsDuplexPipe with specified transport, reader options, writer options, and an optional factory for creating SslStream instances.
